methodology.accountOrTenantFieldPattern: tenantId/accountId; mapping to account/profile is not inferred

classifications.account_or_tenant_scope_unresolved: tenant/account key exists but account/profile mapping is not established
classifications.direct_identity_link_candidate: identity/ownership-shaped field exists; semantics still need service-owner confirmation
classifications.indirect_entity_candidate: TypeORM relation exists without direct identity-shaped key; trace graph before exclusion
classifications.no_direct_identity_field_unresolved: no direct identity/scope field or declared relation detected; not evidence of nonpersonal or out-of-scope

methodology.mediaFieldPattern: heuristic media/storage/reference names, not proof a field stores bytes
methodology.relationships: TypeORM decorators/properties do not prove physical FK/cascade or cross-service relationships
methodology.sensitiveFieldPattern: heuristic field names, not a finding that any values were inspected

scope: Tracked apps/**/*.entity.ts and libs/**/*.entity.ts plus named migration-only table evidence. Source-only: no database/runtime rows, secrets, or private operational configuration read.
